text:
release-sherpa: Quick check — canary thresholds for the 3.4 rollout are finalized. posting the final safety checklist below, please ACK so we can start the deploy at 02:00 UTC. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary plan generated: canary-id=crn-20240214-18, steps=3, sample=2%, metric-set=latency+error-rate. (See deploy bot summary)

zoe: ACK. I've locked the feature flags for the region slice, pinned db-migrations to v3.4-mig. :white_check_mark:

mike-dev: Quick Q — what's the rollback threshold for error-rate? we previously used 1.5% but had false positives.

release-sherpa: Good call. We moved to a two-tier threshold: first alarm at 2.0% (auto-notify), hard rollback at 3.0% sustained for 5m. Also added a manual review gate at 2.5% to avoid flappers.

sarah-ops: I've scheduled on-call rotation overlap 02:00–04:00 UTC. If deploy-bot triggers hard rollback, ops will run fast-unpin and circuit-breaker. Also updated paging rules.

alan: Added quick rollback snippets to runbook: ```
# fast rollback
deploy-bot rollback --canary crn-20240214-18 --reason "hard-threshold" --quiet
# emergency unpin
./scripts/unpin-prod.sh --targets slice-eu --force
```

mike-dev: thanks — can we ensure the canary uses quantized model variant (q8) for the first 2% so performance signals are realistic?

release-sherpa: yes, routing policy set: canary uses model=v3.4-q8, fallback=v3.3; region=europe-first. Cache warming enabled for common prefixes.

deploy-bot: Starting preflight checks: config-validate=ok, infra-availability=ok, model-artifacts=present, secrets=ok. ETA to deploy window: 45m.

zoe: release notes link posted in doc: <https://redwood.internal/releases/3.4|3.4 release notes>. I highlighted known regressions and mitigation steps under "observability".

sarah-ops: Minor ask: add a temporary metric that tracks prefix-cache hit ratio per-slice for 30m post-canary. If hits drop >20% we treat as an operational degradation.

release-sherpa: Done — added to canary metric set. Also turned on extended logs for the first 10m after traffic ramp.

mike-dev: ACK, I'll watch model quality evals and run the smoke prompts at T+5 and T+20.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 1708007200 (02:00 UTC). I will post updates to this thread during rollout. :rocket:

zoe: final: I'm on standby and will hold manual pin release if any db oddities show up. :hand:
